description: Deep-dive on one Polymarket market by condition_id: question, category, outcomes with their clob_token_ids, 24h and total volume, liquidity, a price series per outcome, the top 30 holders per side, the last 100 trades (with wallets), tape stats and resolution status. There is no live quote or smart-money block here: use polymarket_orderbook for quotes and polymarket_smart_money for the cohort. Use after polymarket_markets when the user asks about a specific market.
name: polymarket_market_detail
title: Polymarket Market Detail
